disposition_reason: Total arsenic and four arsenic species were measured in 105 Swiss retail rice and rice-based products (rice grains, dry and ready-to-eat baby foods, rice cereals, crackers, milk rice, rice drinks).

study.design: Retail survey of 105 rice and rice-based products consumed by toddlers, with exposure assessment
study.market: grocery stores, drugstores, pharmacies and health food stores, Berne area, Switzerland
study.method: Total As: microwave autoclave HNO3 digestion, sector-field ICP-MS; species: 0.28 M HNO3 extraction at 90 °C, IC-ICP-MS
lod: tAs LOD 3.44, LOQ 10.3 µg/kg; LOD As(III) 0.29, As(V) 0.37, MMA 0.50, DMA 0.81 µg/kg; LOQ As(III) 0.87, As(V) 1.13, MMA 1.50, DMA 2.45 µg/kg
study.qa: NIST 1568b rice flour: tAs 283.7 ± 5.5 vs certified 285 ± 14 µg/kg; spike recoveries As(III) 108%, As(V) 117%, MMA 115%, DMA 100%
